nina: Quick sync: postmortem INC-2026 follow-ups. We need a compact runbook page (triage + commands + PD ladder) and a single tracking issue for owners. Dropping owners/timelines here.

omar: I'll own the runbook edits (triage checklist + exact commands). Will draft a one-pager and PR by Thu.

claire: I'll own escalation and PagerDuty entries. Proposed ladder: oncall -> infra lead at 15m -> ops lead at 30m -> region-fallback kickoff at 45m. I'll prepare PD snippets by Wed.

nina: Good. Also include an entry for deploy-correlation quick rollback steps since we saw multiple incidents tied to recent model pushes.

omar: Draft triage snippet (to be included in PR):```bash
# inspect recent KV evictions
rictl logs svc/inference --since 10m | jq 'select(.event=="kv_evict")' | tail -n 40
# check shard hit ratio
redwood-metrics query 'kv_cache_hit_ratio{shard="inference"}' --last 5m
# dry-run manual eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --dry-run
# apply eviction
rictl exec svc/inference --force-kv-evict --shard=inference --confirm
```

claire: Add a decision rule: if >60% of evictions map to single api_key -> throttle key and contact CS; else use global eviction + canary rotate. I'll add templates.

devops-bot: [ops-bot] Playbook draft created: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/kv-evict-compact - owners: omar (runbook), claire (escalation).

nina: Timeline recap: omar PR by Thu, claire PD entries by Wed, nina will open GH issue to track subtasks and follow up next Monday. If anything slips, call it out here so we can reassign. :white_check_mark:
